scope: Independent narrow LSE ownership schema/data/generator review. Technical acceptance only; no legal clearance or HAL/silicon validation claim.

schema_contract.change: Append optional ClockLimits.lse and add Lse/PeripheralLse with exactly two bool fields, pin_lock then pin_lock_requires_enable_lock.
schema_contract.existing_contracts: Removing the two exact insertion runs in each model recovers Stage41 bytes. Existing types, widths, field order, defaults, derives and historical extensions are unchanged.
schema_contract.wire: Serde model absent/null lse deserialize to None and serialize with lse omitted. Generator-owned model absent/null lse default to None; static metadata has Option<PeripheralLse>. A present record requires both real JSON booleans. false values remain explicit.
schema_contract.validation_boundary: The schema represents all four bool pairs; source validation rejects pin_lock=false with pin_lock_requires_enable_lock=true. None denotes source-qualified absence of LSE IP, not an unbonded package. Package pin absence is independent.
schema_contract.rust_source_compatibility: Downstream direct ClockLimits/PeripheralClockLimits struct literals must supply the added lse field. JSON compatibility does not imply Rust source compatibility.

source_and_projection.evidence_correspondence: Byte-identical copy of 2026-10-09 independent LSE source audit sources.json; it describes its historical Stage40 baseline.
source_and_projection.lock_chain: Electrical policy hash, audit hash, source/catalog locks, selected own-family manual/datasheet SHA-256 and chip_scope all checked.
source_and_projection.registers: All selected IR inspected: F002/F003 lack LSE and CR1.LSEEN/LSELOCK; other 11 families have LSE at 0x24, CR1 at 0x04, LSEEN[4]/LSELOCK[5]/MODE[6] each width 1. PINLOCK[17] width 1 exists exactly for L010/L011/L012. No enum or array substitution.
source_and_projection.generation_guards: build.rs::generate_lse requires metadata Option presence to equal actual selected IR LSE presence; None also requires absent LSEEN/LSELOCK fields and LSE pin signals. It validates widths/offsets/readable registers and PINLOCK existence. Pin projection consumes OSC32 aliases with no digital AF, exactly one GPIO identity, and intersection across package aliases.
source_and_projection.package_result: All 54 generated selector JSON files, including 37 catalog selectors, match own-source package rows and physical positions. L010 is PB1 input/PB0 output; other bonded families use PC14/PC15. Unbonded packages and aliases without common pads retain no projected pad. L012 projection is independent of HSE support.
source_and_projection.ownership_fact_result: L010 pad lock uses PINLOCK alone; L011/L012 require PINLOCK && LSELOCK; other families have no separate pad lock. These are conservative reservation facts, not universal hardware write-blocking guarantees or LSE setup qualification.
